notes: Step 1 was right, so I made no changes to the parts. This tutorial is a software-only HTML/CSS project. It positions images (face, eyes1-3, mouth1) on a web page with CSS, and it has no physical hardware.

The graph has no parts and no connections. There is no breadboard, board, wire, LED, resistor or sensor to join. The CSS 'top' and 'left' offsets place images on a page and are not electrical or mechanical connections.
